description: Sublim Air-Conditioned Apartment, Renovated in February 2024 - Elegance and Comfort in the Heart of ParisA Prime Location in a Charming Pedestrian StreetEnjoy the serenity of a peaceful pedestrian street while staying in the vibrant heart of Paris.
